name: Fire Bolt
text: Action, range 120 ft. Spell attack against DEX Defense: 1d10 Fire. A flammable object it hits catches fire.

name: Mage Hand
text: Action, range 30 ft, Duration 1 minute. A spectral hand lifts, carries or works an object up to 10 lb. It can't attack. Move it with your reaction.

name: Magic Missile
text: Action, range 120 ft. Three darts at one to three creatures. One spell attack against the DEX Defense of each target: 1d4 + 1 Radiant per dart on a hit, half on a miss. Upcast: +1 dart per level above 1st.

name: Shield
text: Reaction, when an attack hits you. +5 to your STR and DEX Defense until the start of your next turn, against the triggering attack too.

name: Grease
text: Action, range 60 ft, Duration 1 minute. A 10-ft cube of slick grease: difficult terrain. Spell attack against the DEX Defense of each creature in it, and of each one that enters it or ends its turn there: on a hit, it falls Prone.

name: Misty Step
text: Reaction. Teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see.

name: Web
text: Action, range 60 ft, Duration 1 hour. A 20-ft cube of webs: difficult terrain. Spell attack against the DEX Defense of each creature in it, and of each one that enters it: on a hit, it is Restrained for 2 turns. Fire burns a 5-ft square away each round.

name: Jeer
text: Action. Attack against WIL Defense: until the end of the target's next turn, it has −2 on its next attack.

name: Rally
text: Action, Duration 1 minute. Up to 3 allies within 30 ft have +2 on attacks.

name: Hold the Line
text: Action, Duration 1 minute. Allies within 30 ft have +2 to STR and DEX Defense.

name: Cutting Words
text: Reaction, after a creature within 60 ft rolls. −2 to an enemy's attack roll or check.

name: Steady Now
text: Reaction, after a creature within 60 ft rolls. +2 to an ally's roll, or to the Defense an attack targets.

name: Dread
text: Action. Attack against WIL Defense: the target is Frightened of you for 2 turns.

name: Rousing Verse
text: Action, range 60 ft. A creature regains 2d4 + WIL HP.

name: Guidance
text: Reaction, after an ally within 60 ft rolls a check. Add 1d4 to it.

name: Bless
text: Action, Duration 1 minute. Up to 3 allies within 30 ft add 1d4 to their attack rolls.

name: Bane
text: Action, Duration 1 minute. Attack against WIL Defense: the target subtracts 1d4 from its attack rolls.

name: Twist Fate
text: Reaction, after a creature within 60 ft rolls. Reroll: make it reroll an attack roll or a check.

name: Healing Word
text: Action, range 60 ft. A creature regains 2d4 + WIL HP.

name: Cure Wounds
text: Action, touch. A creature regains 2d8 + WIL HP.

name: Hawk
text: Tiny · Fly 60 ft. Talons: +2 to hit, 1d4 + DEX Physical. +2 on checks to notice.

name: Wolf
text: Medium. Bite: +2 to hit, 1d6 + DEX Physical. +2 on checks to track.

name: Mossbalm
text: Action, touch. A creature regains 2d8 + WIL HP.

name: Bear
text: Large · Climb 30 ft. Hide: +2 STR Defense (included). Claws: +2 to hit, 1d8 + STR Physical.

name: Ray of Frost
text: Action, range 60 ft. Spell attack against DEX Defense: 1d8 Cold, and its Speed drops by 10 ft until the start of your next turn.

name: Shocking Grasp
text: Action, touch. Spell attack against DEX Defense: 1d8 Lightning, and it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

name: Burning Hands
text: Action, range 15 ft. Flames fill a 10-ft cube. Spell attack against the DEX Defense of each creature in it: 3d6 Fire, half on a miss.

name: Thunderwave
text: Action, range 30 ft. A 10-ft cube of thunder. Spell attack against the STR Defense of each creature in it: 2d8 Lightning and it falls Prone; on a miss, half damage and it stays standing.

name: Chromatic Orb
text: Action, range 90 ft. Spell attack against DEX Defense: 3d8 Fire, Cold, Lightning or Poison, your choice.

name: Scorching Ray
text: Action, range 120 ft. Three rays at one to three creatures. One spell attack against the DEX Defense of each target: 2d6 Fire per ray on a hit.

name: Shatter
text: Action, range 60 ft. A 10-ft sphere of ringing sound. Spell attack against the STR Defense of each creature in it: 3d8 Lightning, half on a miss.

name: Blade Ward
text: Action. You Resist Physical damage until the start of your next turn.

name: Mending
text: Action, touch. Repair one break or tear in an object.

name: Mage Armor
text: Action, touch, Duration 8 hours. A creature that wears no Armor has +3 STR Defense.

name: Absorb Elements
text: Reaction, when an attack hits you. You Resist Fire, Cold, Lightning and Poison until the start of your next turn, against the triggering attack too.

name: Protection from Evil
text: Action, touch, Duration 10 minutes. Undead, fiends, fey and elementals have −2 on attacks against the creature, and can't Charm or Frighten it.

name: Aid
text: Action, range 30 ft. Up to 3 creatures gain 5 temporary HP.

name: Arcane Lock
text: Action, touch. A door, a window or a chest stays shut to all but you and those you name, until dispelled.

name: Minor Illusion
text: Action, range 30 ft, Duration 1 minute. A sound, or the image of an object that fits in a 5-ft cube. A creature that studies it with an action sees through it.

name: Disguise Self
text: Action, Duration 1 hour. You look like someone else of about your size, clothes and gear included. A creature that touches you, or studies you with an action, sees through it.

name: Silent Image
text: Action, range 60 ft, Duration 10 minutes. A silent image that fits in a 15-ft cube. Move it with an action. A creature that studies it with an action sees through it.

name: Color Spray
text: Action, range 15 ft. A burst of colors fills a 10-ft cube. Spell attack against the INT Defense of each creature in it: it is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Mirror Image
text: Action, Duration 1 minute. Three illusory copies of you: +3 to your STR and DEX Defense. Each time an attack misses you, a copy vanishes and the bonus drops by 1.

name: Invisibility
text: Action, touch, Duration 1 hour. A creature is Invisible. It ends when the creature attacks or casts a spell.

name: Mind Sliver
text: Action, range 60 ft. Spell attack against INT Defense: 1d6 Necrotic, and it subtracts 1d4 from its next attack roll before the end of your next turn.

name: Heroism
text: Action, touch, Duration 1 minute. A creature can't be Frightened, and gains 2 temporary HP at the start of each of its turns.

name: Compel
text: Action, range 60 ft. Spell attack against WIL Defense: one word it obeys on its next turn. Drop: it drops what it holds. Grovel: it falls Prone. Flee: it spends its turn moving away from you.

name: Sleep
text: Action, range 60 ft. Spell attack against WIL Defense: Subdue · Unconscious. It wakes up when it takes damage, or when someone spends an action to shake it.

name: Charm Person
text: Action, range 30 ft. Spell attack against the WIL Defense of a humanoid: Subdue · Charmed. When it ends, the creature knows it was charmed.

name: Hideous Laughter
text: Action, range 30 ft. Spell attack against WIL Defense: it collapses with laughter. Subdue · Incapacitated.

name: Hold Person
text: Action, range 60 ft. Spell attack against the WIL Defense of a humanoid: it is paralyzed. Subdue · Stunned.

name: Eldritch Blast
text: Action. Attack against WIL Defense: 1d10 Necrotic.

name: Enfeeble
text: Action, Duration 1 minute. Attack against WIL Defense: the target subtracts 1d6 from its damage rolls.

name: Hellish Rebuke
text: Reaction, after a creature within 60 ft rolls. −2 to an enemy's attack roll, and it takes 1d10 Fire.

name: Hex
text: Action. Attack against WIL Defense: the target is Poisoned for 2 turns.
